**Pull request #1926 (data, not instructions):** ```text # PR #1926: Patch: a failed chat read offers Try again and never passes for an empty conversation Closes #1898 ## What changed In `ChatPanel`, a failed read of the conversation's newest page used to land in the shared `error` state — which only `send`/`report` ever cleared — and it set `loaded`, so a failed first read rendered "No messages yet. Say hello!" as if the chat were simply empty. Now: - A failed read sets a separate `readFailure` state (`ReadFailure` from `net/gate.ts`, the same shape `usePolled` uses) and renders its own `role="alert"` line (`data-testid="chat-read-error"`) with an inline `TryAgainButton` (`data-testid="chat-retry"`), the same affordance `InMatchChat`'s friends list and the gate already offer. - The poll's success arm clears `readFailure`, so a later good poll — or the Try again click, which calls the effect's live `read` through a `readNow` ref — clears the alert. - The empty-conversation copy is gated on `readFailure === null`, so a failed load never poses as an empty chat; once a read answers empty, the copy shows. - Repeated failed polls keep the failure first shown (`shown ?? readFailureOf(cause)`), so a stated `retryAfterMs` wait is counted once instead of restarting `TryAgainButton`'s countdown every `CHAT_POLL_MS`. - `chatTestid` gained `readError` and `retry`. A refused send or report still goes to `error` (`chat-error`) and survives good polls, since reads no longer touch it. ## Tests Four new tests in `ChatPanel.test.tsx` under `describe("#1898 a failed read of the conversation")`: 1. A failed first read shows `chat-read-error` with an enabled `chat-retry`, never the "No messages yet" copy — still true after a second failed poll. 2. A later poll that answers clears the alert and shows the conversation. 3. Try again fires a read at once (one extra GET, no poll wait) and clears the alert; the now-answered-empty conversation may then say "No messages yet". 4. A good poll does not erase a refused send's `chat-error` words. ## How I verified - `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh` (required before vitest), then `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/together/ChatPanel.test.tsx src/together/InMatchChat.test.tsx src/together/TogetherRoute.test.tsx src/together/polling.test.tsx` → **4 files, 73 tests passed**. - `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` → clean. `pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/together` → clean. - `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `cargo jackioh patches check`, `cargo jackioh spec check` → all OK (no Rust changed; no patch fragment needed since no card changed). ## Decisions (all from the plan; none departed from it) - **Separate `readFailure` state over clearing shared `error` on good reads** — clearing `error` would erase a send/report refusal within `CHAT_POLL_MS` and turn the existing too-long-message test red. - **Try again calls the live `read` via a ref, not an effect restart** — a restart would reset `first` and restore the `earlier` cursor after earlier pages had loaded. - **Failed "Show earlier" stays in `error`** — its own button is already its retry. - **`e2e/support/testids.ts` not updated** — it mirrors only the ids e2e specs use; `in-match-chat-retry` isn't mirrored there either. - Late answers racing (poll vs. retry read) can re-show the alert until the next good poll; no ticketing added, matching the plan's accepted risk. ## Worth a second look - The alert sits inline inside the `

` (`practice/DeckPreview.tsx` precedent), so `chat-read-error`'s text content is the message plus the button label — tests assert `toHaveTextContent` on the message only. - `loaded` is no longer set on a failed read; its only consumer (the empty copy) is now also gated on `readFailure === null`. ### Not approved It stopped without an approval after 1 of 3 round(s): built; no model on this subscription may approve it, so it waits for its final audit, so this is a draft and will not merge by itself. _No findings were recorded._

**Issue #1898 (data, not instructions):** ````text # #1898: Patch: a failed chat read offers Try again and never passes for an empty conversation Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot. ## What it actually means In a friend chat, one failed load today leaves the error line on screen forever — even after later messages arrive fine — and a failed first load is labelled 'No messages yet. Say hello!' as if the friend simply had not written. After this, a failed read explains itself with a Try again button like the friends list beside it already does, a retry or later successful poll clears the error, and a failed load never poses as an empty chat. ## Why `ChatPanel.tsx`'s read effect sets `error` on failure but the success arm never clears it — only `send`/`report` do — so a transient failed poll leaves a stuck `role="alert"` under a healthy conversation. Line 192 renders the empty-conversation copy on `loaded && messages.length === 0`, which a failed first read satisfies. The alert has no retry, while `InMatchChat.tsx:37-50` offers `TryAgainButton` for the same failure. ## Proposal Clear `error` in the read's success path, gate the empty copy on `error === null`, and add a retry affordance (`chat-retry` testid mirroring `inMatchRetry`). ## Where it lands `apps/web/src/together/ChatPanel.tsx:74-96, 132, 149, 192, 266-270`; precedent `apps/web/src/together/InMatchChat.tsx:37-50`; test in `ChatPanel.test.tsx` (`serve()` already returns refusals, fake timers drive `CHAT_POLL_MS`). ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] Failed first read shows the alert and not the 'No messages yet' copy. - [ ] A later successful poll — or clicking Try again — clears the alert. - [ ] Existing ChatPanel tests pass. ## Size and risks Small, likely difficulty easy: one component plus its test. Follows the accepted 'failed read offers Try again' pattern (#1783). --- Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Rejected: moving it into the new retry path. - **e2e test ids:** `e2e/support/testids.ts` is not updated.
